title: Ahnentafel_Index
description: Structured Ahnentafel ancestor index mapping sequential lineage numbers to canonical person records.

schema_version.description: Version identifier for the Ahnentafel index schema.

last_modified.description: [REQUIRED] ISO-8601 date of last index compilation.

total_ancestors.description: [REQUIRED] Total count of ancestor entries cataloged in the index.

ancestors.description: [REQUIRED] Sequential list of ancestor records mapped by Ahnentafel numbers.

ahnentafel_number.description: [REQUIRED] Mathematical position of the ancestor in the pedigree tree.

person.description: [REQUIRED] Lightweight person identifier and assembled display name.
